Chapter 687 - 687 Congratulations; Top-Notch Spatial Law Talent

Chapter 687 - 687 Congratulations; Top-Notch Spatial Law Talent

687 Congratulations; Top-Notch Spatial Law Talent

Compared to when he entered the secret realm, Lin Fan’s strength and speed had both increased tremendously.

However, he did not shake off Qing Song, Ma Zheng, Feng Yue, and the others because of this. Instead, he maintained the same pace as them.

A few hours later, the four of them finally returned to the surface.

Soon, they also noticed the gorgeous words floating in the air—’Congratulations!’

Just as Lin Fan raised his head, an explosive sound suddenly rang out in the sky. The entire sky shook violently.

Then, large fireworks appeared around the gorgeous words. They were like fireworks that shook the sky and covered the sun. They were extremely brilliant.

Many people from Qing Planet exclaimed in admiration.

“What big fireworks!”

“So beautiful!”

“Where did these fireworks come from?”

…

Even Star Lord Feng Yue, who was standing beside him, had a glint in her eyes. She could not help but say, “So beautiful!”

A gust of wind blew, and the word ‘Congratulations’ and the fireworks disappeared into thin air.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan was entranced. He had a strange feeling that all of this was prepared for him.

Could it be the system?

If that was the case, then who was the system’s leveler?

After a while, Lin Fan suppressed the thought in his heart.

Qing Song said, “Senior, there are still a few other friends. Let’s go to the Qing Hall to rest.”

“Alright.” Lin Fan nodded.

Feng Yue and Ma Zheng had no objections.

After a while, they returned to the palace.

Qing Song took out a treasure chest filled with spirit crystals that contained pure energy and said respectfully, “Senior Lin, here are 100 spirit crystals. Please accept them.”

Originally, he had promised Lin Fan ten spirit crystals.

However, the strength that Lin Fan had displayed made Qing Song feel that ten spirit crystals were not enough to pay him.

Even 100 spirit crystals was too little in Qing Song’s opinion.

However, this was what he had accumulated over the years.

Lin Fan did not stand on ceremony either. Waving his hand, he placed the spirit crystals into his internal space.

At this moment, a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve completed the hidden mission. Congratulations, you’ve obtained Flame Armor and Top-Notch Spatial Law Talent.]

[Flame Armor: Emperor-grade armor with powerful defense and rebound attack power.]

[Top-Notch Spatial Law Talent: A powerful talent that can quickly comprehend spatial law.]

Looking at the fiery red armor in his mind, Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

With this armor, safety in this vast universe should be guaranteed.

After that, he placed his attention on Top-Notch Spatial Law Talent.

Lin Fan felt the space around him and wanted to jump into it. It was really amazing.

He understood that it would be very easy to cultivate spatial power in the future.

When Qing Song saw that Lin Fan had accepted the spirit crystals, he heaved out a sigh of relief.

Then, he turned to Feng Yue and Ma Zheng and said, “This is your reward, friends.”

After saying that, he took out a total of 20 spirit crystals.

Then, the few of them started chatting in the hall.

They first lamented about the Abyss Mystic Realm and the Bug Queen. Then, they talked about some of the things that happened in the Spring Region.

As they spoke, they were paying attention to Lin Fan’s changes.

When they saw that Lin Fan’s expression did not change at all, they finally calmed down.

Lin Fan’s face was calm, but he was actually listening intently to the conversation between the three of them.

From the conversation between the three of them, he learned more about the universe.

It turned out that above the Star Traveller level was the Planet level, and above that was the Domain Lord level and Universe level.

Lin Fan could not help but think of his Flame Armor. It was of the emperor level. What level was the equipment?

“The Heavenly Wind World will open in a while,” Ma Zheng said. “Friends, do you have any thoughts of entering it?”

As he said this, his eyes were fixed on Lin Fan.

This was because the Heavenly Wind World was only limited to people below 10,000 years old.

Qing Song was already more than 30,000 years old. Feng Yue was slightly younger, but she was also more than 10,000 years old.

Obviously, none of them could enter.

Only Ma Zheng, who was 9,200 years old, was qualified. He was also considered a genius.

He wanted to enter the Heavenly Wind World to roam around.

[Ding! Mission: Enter the Heavenly Wind World. Rewards: One Emperor-grade equipment, one Emperor-grade cultivation technique, one epiphany of heaven and earth.]

Lin Fan said, “I’ll go with you to the Heavenly Wind World.”

“It’s great to be able to go with Senior!” Ma Zheng said in surprise and joy.

The reason why he suddenly mentioned the Heavenly Wind World was because he had thought that Lin Fan might not have lived for so long.

That was because Lin Fan looked way too young.

However, after hearing his words, it was inevitable that they would be shocked.

He possessed such unimaginable power and was so young.

Genius! He was definitely a rare genius!

When Qing Song and Feng Yue heard this, they were also shocked.

They did not look down on Lin Fan just because he was young.

On the contrary, they looked at Lin Fan with even more respect.

That was because the younger he was, the more terrifying his future would be. In fact, he might even have an extraordinary background.

At this moment, a few crisp notifications rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Qing Song’s favorability toward you has increased to two stars.]

[Ding! Feng Yue’s favorability toward you has increased to two stars.]

[Ding! Ma Zheng’s favorability toward you has increased to three stars.]

Lin Fan and Ma Zheng stayed on Qing Planet for a few more days before boarding the interstellar ship and heading toward the direction of the Heavenly Wind World.

They could indeed fly through the primordial chaos.

However, since he could lie down and rest, why would he waste his energy?

The interior of the star-class spaceship was extremely spacious.

Lin Fan stood in front of the gigantic protective shield and looked at the chaotic universe. The space around him was constantly distorting as he was entranced.

Slowly, the space around Lin Fan started to twist and turn like a liquid.

A mysterious and majestic aura appeared on the interstellar spaceship. It even rippled outside the interstellar spaceship.

In the next moment…

The speed of the interstellar spaceship suddenly soared.

After the spaceship pilot noticed the change, he said in panic, “This is bad. A terrifying unknown power has appeared in the spaceship! Everyone, be careful!”

“Our speed has increased by more than ten times! Moreover, it’s still increasing!”

“What exactly happened?”

“We’re done for!”

…

The entire spaceship was in a mess.

Ma Zheng, who was also in the interstellar spaceship, hurried over to Lin Fan’s side.

When he sensed the thick space energy around Lin Fan, his face was filled with shock.

As expected of Senior Lin!

His usage of spatial power had actually reached such a level!

Moreover, the spatial power was still increasing!

There was also the aura that pervaded Senior Lin’s body…

Was Senior Lin cultivating?

At the thought of this, Ma Zheng hurriedly turned around and told everyone in the spaceship not to panic. They were not allowed to make any noise or do anything to disturb Lin Fan.
